officialDocumentation.contract: createUser is a server-only Auth Admin operation; email_confirm:true confirms the newly created identity without disabling project-wide confirmation. A server credential must remain server-side.

officialDashboard.observedState: Normal sign-in page, not a bot block or missing project.
officialDashboard.reasonNoPromptYet: Coordinator is managing existing migration/Expo confirmation windows; the browserAuth flow requires the user's method choice and secure entry.

conclusion: An existing server-side admin credential is configured, so public-client keys alone do not prove account creation impossible. The reviewed app interfaces do not expose ordinary disposable-user creation, and current CI has no such configured acceptance harness. The official Auth dashboard is a supported remaining route after ordinary sign-in; no privileged endpoint or credential export was introduced.
